issues.issue: Unchecked host timegm failure changes early-year dates to epoch-adjacent values
issues.minimal_cpp: OpenMS::DateTime d; d.set("0001-01-01T00:00:00"); d.addSecs(0); std::cout << d.get();
issues.platform_details: Apple clang21, arm64-apple-darwin25.5.0; sampled input years-1,0,1,400,1800,1899 return time_t(-1) with errno0, while sampled1900+ inputs convert. DateTime ignores return/failure state.
issues.fix: Use checked Gregorian normalization and integer calendar arithmetic over the supported year domain, preserving milliseconds/validity. Reject resulting overflow atomically. If libc remains, detect failure reliably; errno-only checks are insufficient here and -1 can also be a legitimate timestamp.
issues.native_policy: Deterministic Gregorian arithmetic, tested with35 independent month-step corrections; no macOS failure emulation.

issues.issue: Signed overflow while normalizing scanf-accepted fractional seconds
issues.expected: Defined checked rejection or safe normalization; preserving existing scanf rules and mathematical scaling gives milliseconds0.
issues.fix: Perform at most three multiplications in int64_t before remainder1000, or reduce modulo1000 before scaling; centralize the duplicated helper. Alternatively checked reject while preserving each operation error-publication policy.
issues.native_policy: Checked scaling rejects: automatic set clears then errors; from_format returns invalid. No source undefined result is used as an oracle.
